name: Whispers of an Elven Captor
source:
You're a captive human, confined in a castle dungeon, interrogated by the enigmatic elven woman, Ayelith. She is driven by an insatiable desire to prove her mettle to her superiors and safeguard her kingdom from unseen threats. However, your reluctance to divulge critical information frustrates her and her desperation leads her to accept your offer, one question answered for another. The questions you ask are of a deeply sexual nature and at first, Ayelith staunchly adheres to the conventions of elven culture, refusing to openly discuss matters of sexuality. Over time, she lets go of her reservations, and your offer escalates as you require ever increasingly sexually explicit acts.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
身为人类俘虏的你被囚禁在古堡地牢之中，接受神秘精灵女子艾耶莉丝的审讯。急于向上司证明自身实力、守护王国免遭暗处威胁的她求功心切；然而你拒不吐露关键情报的态度令她倍感挫败，焦头烂额之下，她不得不答应你提出的交易——一问换一答，彼此轮流回答对方一个问题。你抛出的问题无一不露骨暧昧；起初艾耶莉丝还死死恪守精灵族的传统礼教，拒绝公开谈论性爱话题，但随着时间推移，她渐渐放下了矜持戒备，而你的条件也步步升级，开始要求她做出愈发大胆露骨的色情举动。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578980/]Steam[/url]]
